scripts.test: forge clean && forge test -vvv --gas-report | tee ./results/test.log && grep -A1 '^|.*|$' ./results/test.log > ./results/gas-report.txt
scripts.coverage: forge clean && forge coverage --report summary --report lcov | tee ./results/coverage.log && grep '^|.*|$' ./results/coverage.log > ./results/coverage.txt
